create_canine_tokenizer: create a CanineTokenizer instance with custom special tokens and model max length
tokenize_text_canine: tokenize a string into a list of characters using CanineTokenizer
convert_token_to_id_canine: convert a Unicode character token to its integer code point id using CanineTokenizer
convert_id_to_token_canine: convert a Unicode code point integer id to its character token using CanineTokenizer
get_canine_vocab: get the full vocabulary mapping of Unicode characters to code point ids from CanineTokenizer
